sentence: This project uses a large observational database to compare how well and how safely medications work for patients with alcohol use disorder.
This project tries to help researchers access and analyze the data that are available to address the growing burden of cancer.
This project tries to find out how a target could help with treatment of migraine and temporomandibular disorders that occur together.
This project builds free, open-source software that combines medical images with robots to support robot-assisted surgery.
This project builds methods that help explain how deep learning models make decisions when reading genomics data.
This project studies how iron and redox regulation pathways connect in single-celled yeast and in yeast that cause fungal infections.
This project provides technologies and facilities that support vision research.
This project uses neuroscience and a social-ecological framework to build and evaluate a multi-year interdisciplinary program.
This project builds a molecular classification system for immune diseases to guide diagnosis and treatment.
This project studies how a thrombopoietin mimetic can help intestinal crypt regeneration and survival of mice exposed to partial body irradiation.
This project builds a workflow that uses five measurement techniques at the same time to identify the chemical structures of unknown fatty acids and lipids.
This project builds computer tools to find ligands for challenging targets in conditions like pain, drug abuse, and cancer.
This project builds an artificial intelligence system that automatically plans stereotactic radiosurgery for patients with multiple brain metastases.
This project builds viral vectors that change gene expression in the cardiac conduction system to study and treat cardiac arrhythmias.
This project studies why heart failure with preserved ejection fraction is more common in women, using mice and human cohorts.
This project uses zebrafish models and brain imaging to find abnormal brain networks that cause seizures in genetic epilepsies.
This project uses single cell sequencing to study how patients respond to treatments for chronic graft versus host disease after hematopoietic stem cell transplantation.
This project uses spinal delivery of a CRISPR platform to change sodium and potassium channels in sensory neurons involved in chronic pain after arthritis.
This project tries to understand how specific inhibitors for lymphoma can enhance immunotherapy responses.
This project studies risk factors for suicidal behavior in people with major depressive disorder and bipolar disorder.
